say: Reach is how many different accounts saw your post. It shows how far it travelled.

panel.heading: From vanity numbers to real value
items: Reach: how many accounts saw it
Engagement rate: engagements ÷ reach × 100
Messages and link clicks: moving to buy
Orders: write them in your own sheet

say: Engagement rate is engagements divided by reach, times 100. Zainab, who sells beaded jewellery in Kano, had a Reel reach 3,200 accounts with 160 engagements. That is 5 percent.

say: But a plain product photo that reached only 600 accounts brought 11 WhatsApp chats, because it had a price and a clear call to action.

say: Platforms cannot see sales in WhatsApp or by transfer, so keep your own sheet: date, platform, post, reach, enquiries, orders and revenue. Ask every buyer where they found you.

say: Here is a worked example. Ifeoma runs a bakery in Owerri. A local food reviewer with about 15,000 followers, mostly in Imo State, offers to promote her.
First she checks. His last 10 Reels get real comments asking where to buy, and most followers are in Owerri.

say: After delivery, ask for a review and a photo. Patience, who sells children's clothes in Benin City, pinned a short delivery and exchange policy as a quick reply, and the repeated questions and disputes dropped.

say: Know the common scams. Fake bank alerts by SMS. Edited payment screenshots. Overpayment stories asking you to refund the difference. Links to click to receive payment.
Confirm every payment in your own app before releasing goods, and never share your PIN, OTP or login.

panel.heading: Never release goods on these
items: Fake bank alerts by SMS
Edited payment screenshots
Overpayment: please refund the difference
Links to click to receive payment
Requests for your PIN, OTP or login

say: Grow my page is not a goal you can check. And posting daily for two weeks, then going silent, helps nobody.

panel.heading: Goals that guide you
right: Three posts a week for 12 weeks

say: A SMART goal is specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and time-bound. For example, get 60 WhatsApp enquiries and 20 orders from Instagram between January and March. Three posts a week for 12 weeks beats daily posting and then silence.

panel.heading: Goals that guide you
right: Three posts a week for 12 weeks

say: Hauwa runs a tailoring shop in Jos, with about 5 hours a week for marketing. Her goal is 90 WhatsApp enquiries and 30 orders from social media in 90 days.

panel.heading: Hauwa's 90-day plan
items: Goal: 90 enquiries, 30 orders in 90 days
Instagram main, Facebook support, WhatsApp
Three posts a week, batched on Sunday
Ads about ₦1,000 a day; break-even ₦4,000
Review on the last Saturday of each month

say: To remember. Judge posts by enquiries and orders, not likes. Check partners before paying, and track with a code. Use a business account and a pinned policy. Confirm every payment in your own app. And set SMART goals with a monthly review.
